# HyperCLI Voice

Load the `hypercli-auth` skill before making a remote request. It defines the
canonical authentication and credential-safety rules. Read
`/opt/hypercli/docs/cli/commands/voice.mdx` when exact flags matter, and run the
installed command help before relying on remembered options.

```bash
hyper voice tts --help
hyper voice design --help
hyper voice clone --help
hyper voice transcribe --help
```

## Text-to-speech

```bash
hyper voice tts "Hello world" --out speech.mp3
hyper voice tts "Hello world" --voice serena --stream --out speech.mp3 --json
```

TTS defaults to voice `serena`. Without `--stream`, it requests one assembled
audio file. With `--stream`, it uses `/ws/voice` and saves collected chunks.
Without `--out`, TTS creates `tts-<timestamp>.mp3` in the current directory; use
an explicit `--out` path in automated work.

## Voice Design

```bash
hyper voice design "Hello world" --description "warm upbeat narrator" --out designed.mp3
hyper voice design "Hello world" --desc "calm low-pitched narrator" --rest --out designed.mp3 --json
```

Design creates speech from a voice description instead of a reference file.
`--description` is the primary flag; `--desc` and `-d` are accepted aliases. By
default, design uses `/ws/voice`; `--rest` posts to `/agents/voice/design`.
Without `--out`, design writes generated audio bytes to stdout. Use `--out`
whenever `--json` is requested.

## Voice Clone

```bash
hyper voice clone "Hello world" --file reference.wav --out cloned.mp3
hyper voice clone "Hello world" --url https://example.com/reference.wav --out cloned.mp3
hyper voice clone "Hello world" --file reference.wav --rest --out cloned.mp3 --json
```

Provide exactly one reference source: `--file` for local audio or `--url` for
client-side HTTPS download before the SDK sends reference bytes. The TypeScript
CLI rejects localhost plus private, link-local, multicast, and reserved IP
literal URLs. Reference audio is capped at 25MiB. Without `--out`, clone writes
generated audio bytes to stdout. Use `--out` whenever `--json` is requested.

## Transcription

```bash
hyper voice transcribe speech.wav
hyper voice transcribe speech.wav --language en
hyper voice transcribe speech.wav --rest --out transcript.txt --json
```

By default, transcription uses `/ws/voice/transcribe`. `--rest` posts to
`/agents/voice/transcribe`. Use transcription to validate generated smoke audio
when a round trip is useful.

## Preflight

1. Confirm the text, destination path, and that the user expects a remote voice
   call.
2. Validate identity and voice capability with `hyper me`; an account without
   voice capability will fail.
3. Treat synthesis text, design descriptions, and clone reference audio as
   remote disclosure, matching `hypercli-auth`.

## Failure Handling

- Missing credentials: run `hyper configure` or set `HYPER_API_KEY`; do not
  search for, print, or suggest exposing credentials.
- Capability errors: report the API message and ask for a voice-capable key or
  plan.
- Generation failures: keep stderr and JSON stdout intact for debugging.
